name: The Secret Family
source:
Where you have to make decisions to deal with all the women who live in your house. Some will be good and others bad, you will decide which way to go.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/DiamondNovels]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你得作出种种决定，想办法与所有住在你家里的女人打交道。有些决定是好的，有些是坏的，要往哪条路走，由你自己选。

［摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/DiamondNovels]Patreon[/url]］
